title: Koszul self Ext is the dual of the exterior conormal
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], V an open of Z and n a natural number. Suppose that every z∈V has an affine neighborhood U of i(z) for which the ideal i.ker.ideal U [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] is the span of a finite Koszul-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence]. Put C=i*ker(i) using tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], B=i_*O_Z, and G=H^n(RHom_Y(B[0],B[0])) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Then the restriction to V of Hom_Z(exteriorSheaf(C,n),O_Z) [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power, def-pur-sheaf-hom] is isomorphic as an O_V-module to (i*G)|V. The conclusion concerns the dual of the exterior conormal, not an exterior power of the dual, and asserts no compatibility with Yoneda products.

proof.text: Obtain a stalk-surjective O_V-linear comparison from the dual exterior conormal to self Ext. This new statement contains the affine Koszul Hom construction and overlap gluing only; injectivity is not assumed.

At a point choose one regular chart. The regular conormal basis and affine frame make the determinant pairing from the exterior of the conormal dual to the dual exterior conormal surjective on every subopen of that chart. Represent stalk elements by sections on smaller neighborhoods to obtain stalk surjectivity, and transport through open restriction and exteriorSheaf_restrict_iso. This produces a surjective stalk map q from the exterior of the restricted conormal dual to the dual exterior conormal. For the upstream restriction theorem, rewrite exteriorPower as exteriorSheaf at the module and its restriction using [lem-sc-exterior-sheaf-upstream-comparison]; this preserves exactly the legacy objects used by the rest of the argument. Obtain the upstream exteriorPower pairing p₀ and its determinant formula. Define p as exteriorSheafPowerIso(dual C,n).hom followed by p₀ and then dualFunctor.mapIso(exteriorSheafPowerIso(C,n).op).hom. Apply the upstream local pairing theorem directly to p₀. Both comparison section maps are bijections; Function.Bijective.comp gives bijectivity of p on every subopen. This replaces conjugation and cancellation with forward composition, retaining the same stalk-surjectivity argument.

Use the source-library stalk-bases theorem and rewrite its exteriorPower term to exteriorSheaf using exteriorSheaf_eq_exteriorPower. The independent self-Ext stalk-bases theorem gives finite bases for the source of q and the self-Ext target on the same n-element-subset index set. Their basis equivalence is injective. The composite of q with the comparison is surjective, so OrzechProperty.bijective_of_surjective_of_injective over the commutative scheme stalk ring makes that composite bijective. Since q is surjective, injectivity of the composite implies injectivity of the comparison itself. Its surjectivity was already given. Detect a sheaf-module isomorphism by bijectivity on all stalks and package it with asIso. This also handles empty V, degree zero and degrees above the chart length without extra hypotheses.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulRegularImmersion_self_ext_dual_exterior_conormal
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (V : Z.Opens) (n : ℕ)
    (hregular : ∀ z : Z, z ∈ V → ∃ U : Y.affineOpens, i z ∈ U.1 ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → Γ(Y, U.1)),
        Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U ∧
          RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let H := derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf
    let G := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (n : ℤ)).obj
        (H.obj (op (S.obj B), S.obj B))
    let T := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj G)
    let F := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
      (Scheme.Modules.dual (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules) n))
    Nonempty (F ≅ T)
